head: DuoFridge turns your iPhone into a retro fridge with magnets and photos
dek: DuoFridge lets you decorate a retro fridge with magnets and your photos and save it as a wallpaper. It was #2 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: You pick fridge colors, drag and rotate magnets such as flowers, fruits and notes, and turn photos into Polaroid-style pictures. On the iPhone Duo, opening the phone opens the fridge. It costs $1.99 with no in-app purchases, by Bigear Company, and needs iOS 16.4.
where: iPhone and iPhone Duo, App Store, $1.99
means: A small, playful way to make your own wallpaper.
todo: Find DuoFridge in the App Store.
thumb_words: A RETRO FRIDGE ON YOUR PHONE
